blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Among Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers before the Senate impeachment court is Roberto Narvasa Batungbacal. Batungbacal is a partner of Bodota & Batungbacal Law Offices, which he manages with fellow defense counsel, lawyer Ralph Bodota. He is also the grandson of the late former Chief Justice Andres Narvasa. WATCH: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Sept. 22, 2026 Batungbacal was admitted to the Philippine Bar in 2020 after earning degrees in Management Economics and Law from Ateneo de Manila University.
